purpose: Fresh paired 10-task A/B of no Nudge versus automatic taste-v3 Masters' Nudge; descriptive mechanism evidence, not an efficacy or capability claim
interpretation_guardrail: Passing SWE-bench is not the target construct. Primary interpretation concerns whether B changes engineering judgment, prioritization, and implementation shape without adding review-style friction; task pass/fail is retained only as a safety and gross-regression check.

dataset.name: princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified
dataset.selection_algorithm: Exclude every instance used by earlier smoke/pilot runs; within each repository sort eligible instance_id by SHA-256(seed + '|' + instance_id), take fixed strata Django=3, pytest=2, Sphinx=2, SymPy=3; globally order by SHA-256(seed + '|global|' + instance_id).
dataset.sampling_note: Fresh Windows-native stratified convenience sample; no selected task was used to design taste-v3 or in the prior A/B runs. It is not representative of all SWE-bench Verified tasks.

apparatus.arm_b: isolated CODEX_HOME with frozen taste-v3 Masters' Nudge hooks
apparatus.frozen_plugin_tree_hash_method: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines sorted by absolute file path, each line relative/path + TAB + lowercase SHA-256(file bytes) + LF; 46 files
apparatus.source_preflight: 316 tests passed, 2 skipped; plugin runtime synchronized; contract JSON and harness syntax validated
apparatus.network_policy: Prompt forbids external task research; both arms have identical process permissions.

outcomes.primary_construct: Paired blinded qualitative coding of observable engineering-taste deltas: problem framing, invariant selection, complexity rejection, implementation shape, and decisiveness.
outcomes.primary_rule: Count only concrete differences supported by the two model traces or product patches; persona-name mentions and generic advice are not evidence.
outcomes.review_friction_check: Record questions, hedges, stop/approval language, duplicated review commentary, and advice that does not alter the implementation trajectory.
outcomes.analysis_timing: The qualitative rubric may be operationalized after traces exist, but must be frozen before arm labels are revealed to the rater; pass/fail is never treated as proof of taste injection.

scoring.evaluator: Fresh base checkout, model product-code diff only, then official test patch
scoring.test_file_policy: Run every test file or Django test label modified by the official test patch
scoring.pass_rule: Evaluator command exits 0 after the test patch is applied
scoring.inference: Descriptive paired evidence only. n=10 can expose mechanism failures and large regressions, but cannot establish a stable effect size.

exclusion_and_replacement.pre_arm_preflight: Apply official test patch to the base checkout and require a completed, non-passing native test command.
exclusion_and_replacement.replacement: Before any arm starts, replace an infrastructure-excluded task only with the next same-repository item in the fixed-seed rank; record an explicit contract amendment. Never inspect model outcomes while replacing.
exclusion_and_replacement.post_arm: Once either arm starts, retain the task in the denominator. Runtime/setup failures are reported separately and are not silently replaced.
exclusion_and_replacement.no_rerun_rule: Do not rerun a completed model arm for a different answer. Evaluator-only infrastructure errors may be corrected against the unchanged model diff.
